title: explorer.envelope.v1
description: Canonical wrapper every Explorer record is emitted in. The Explorer never speaks Sport Hub's RawSportsEvent shape directly; it emits this envelope, and the Explorer->SportHub adapter (Sprint ML-B) maps it to a RawSportsEvent. Strongly typed so Sport Hub/Atlas can consume without knowing a crawler produced it.

provider.description: Concrete provider/collector id within the source, e.g. 'fbref-match-scraper-v1'.

trust_level.description: Curation trust of the source. Drives whether the record can enter production (high) or only training/low_trust_signal (low/medium). See ML_A_EXPLORER_TO_ATLAS_FLOW.

confidence.description: Per-record extraction confidence. Maps to RawSportsEvent.raw_confidence.

captured_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant the Explorer captured the record (NOT the event time — that lives in the payload).

external_id.description: Source-scoped id of the entity (fixture id, etc.). Maps to RawSportsEvent.external_match_id for match-scoped entities.

canonical_match_id.description: Insight canonical match UUID when already resolved; null when only Sport Hub can resolve it via the identity service. Explorer SHOULD leave null unless it received it from Insight.

competition_key.description: Stable Insight competition slug, e.g. 'brasileirao_serie_a', 'premier_league' (matches the dataset scope keys).

season.description: Season label, e.g. '2022', '2022-2023'. Bounded by Sport Hub's 16-char season limit.

url.description: Origin URL or API path the record came from.

parser.description: Parser/collector version that produced the payload.

checksum.description: Content hash of the raw source artifact (dedup + replay).

then.description: Match-scoped entities require external_id to be the source's match/fixture id.
